chapter: Childhood and first bands in Ohio
title: Born in Springfield, Ohio; parents and two sisters
summary: Jackson gives his birth date, his parents' names and the names and birth years of his two sisters; he is the middle child.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was born in Springfield, Ohio, January 13, 1909.
Was Imogene Jackson. My father's name was Dudley Jackson.
Uh-huh. Where did you -- What town? Springfield, huh?
Uh-huh. How many was in the family?
Uh-huh, and were you older or they? In what order?
I'm in between. I'm in the middle.
Dorothea was my older sister's name and Marguerite was my younger sister's name.
Marguerite was -- my older sister, rather, was born in 1903. I was born in '09 and Marguerite was born in '17.
